Raxxs 0.5 Plant Oracle Druid Endgame Build Guide https://mobalytics.gg/poe-2/builds/plant-druid-oracle-endgame-guide
Conquer the game with Raxxs 0.5 Plant Oracle Druid Endgame Build Guide PoE 2 Druid build! Learn everything about the build: equipment, skill gems, passive tree, gameplay, and mechanics.
Welcome to the Plant Daddy Endgame Build Guide. This builds cruises through the entire Path of Exile 2 endgame while mostly pressing a single button. If you value comfort and not having to have top gear to clear all content - Plant Druid is one of the best options out there. The real beauty of the build comes from our second ascendancy Forced Outcome. Since this guarantees a crit on every cast, we can auto trigger Thunderstorm with Cast on Critical to permanently water our plants - outrageously buffing their damage. For bosses who might actually survive a hit, we take the even stronger plants Thrashing Vines to make quick work of them. Lets learn how to put this together so you can dominate! Leveling Guide: https://mobalytics.gg/poe-2/builds/plant-oracle-druid-leveling-build-guide Live Stream: twitch.tv/raxxanterax
- Giga Clear - "1" Button Build - Clears All Content - Energy Shield Defense
- Needs Chaos Resistance - Defense is Gear Dependent - Mana Starved on Long Fights
This is the poor college student, ramen every night til we make it version. Requires nothing expensive but still gets the job done.
Important: Read Me! I will absolutely be updating the guide within a few days of the league launch with all of the new endgame runes, uniques, etc. Follow the build at the top to be notified of the updates when they go live. Cut Thunderstorm so its exactly level 18 in your Cast on Critical (take your total amount of + spell skills, subtract from 18, and cut that Thunderstorm). Example: If I have a +2 amulet, I would cut level 16 Thunderstorm so its 18 in COC. This is to guarantee drench for guaranteed shock while spending the least amount of Mana possible. We get Sigil of Power from a Chiming Staff in our 2nd Weapon Set. Make sure to set your plant spells to ONLY be cast with your powerful weapon set.
Campaign Quest Rewards: Act 2 - 30% increased Charm Effect Duration/+1 Charm Slot Act 3 - 25% Increased Stun Threshold Act 4 - +5% Lightning Resistance // +5% Cold Resistance // +5% Fire Resistance // 30% Increased Recovery From Flasks Interlude - +5% Elemental Resistances
This atlas tree is being replaced next league, Ill fix it the moment I can.
Mapping - Run forward and cast Entangle to make enemies chase you and step on your plants. They have no chance to survive. - Use Thrashing Vines on Elites and Bosses (3 Entangle to 1 Thrashing Vines). Bosses - Cast Sigil of Power close to the boss, but not on the boss. - Spam Entangle to bring Sigil of Power to Level 4. - When the boss spawns, cast a single Thrashing Vines beneath them. - Try to stay in the Sigil of Power and cast 3 Entangle for every 1 Thrashing Vines. - DO NOT SPAM Thrashing Vines! ITS WAY LESS DPS AND DRAINS YOUR MANA! IF YOU DO THIS I WILL CALL THE POLICE!

Also added Zarokhs Refrain to Thrashing Vines because the spell echos are very strong and the added cooldown doesnt hurt us at all because youre not supposed to spam it anyway. Also picked up Ruin as we path over to the right side. 6/7/26 - Updated some of the equipment because it didnt display properly (rings & flasks). Also made sure Chaos Res was solved on all variants.
